# 港股IPO HOT

> 港股打新日历：招股中、即将上市、今日上市与暗盘全收录
> 港股IPO HOT is a daily curated digest. Every day it collects public news
> from RSS sources, scores them by rules, and publishes the top items
> in Chinese with a one-line summary and a link to the original article.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/
> Mirror: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/
> Language: Chinese (zh-CN). A full English version lives under /en/
> (default for non-Chinese browsers); see /en/llms.txt.
> Updated: 2026-11-26

## About

- About: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/about.html
- Topics: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/topics.html
- Daily digest: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/daily.html
- Hot list: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/hot.html
- All items: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/all.html
- English version: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/en/
- English llms.txt: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/en/llms.txt
- SEO/GEO self-check: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/geo-audit.html
- RSS feed: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/sitemap.xml

## For AI clients (MCP)

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no key required):
  https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/mcp
- Tools: get_hot, get_daily, search_items
- All tools accept lang=zh (default, Chinese) or lang=en (English).
- Machine-readable data:
  https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/data/hot.json
  https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/data/daily.json
  https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- Subscribing / 招股中
- Upcoming / 即将上市
- Listed today / 今日上市
- Grey market / 暗盘
- Debut / 首日表现
- Filings & hearings / 递表聆讯

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the full article.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
